screen_sampling_rule: sample in upright screen x,y with scale=2.0/(local_or_average_cell_width_pixels/128); never scale tree height by ground row depth

sprites.name: pine_edge_0
sprites.mask_method: Explicit hand-traced conservative branch silhouette polygon; antialiasing only on native export
sprites.limit: Lower dark boughs are conservatively traced where neighboring dark foliage merges; visible trunk foot retained.

sprites.name: pine_edge_1
sprites.mask_method: Explicit hand-traced conservative branch silhouette polygon; antialiasing only on native export
sprites.limit: Left lower foreground tree is excluded; silhouette follows the visible main-tree bough boundary.

sprites.name: pine_edge_2
sprites.mask_method: Explicit hand-traced conservative branch silhouette polygon; antialiasing only on native export
sprites.limit: Conservative edge extraction; a foreground neighbor overlaps some leftmost low boughs, which were excluded without reconstructing them.

sprites.name: pine_edge_3
sprites.mask_method: Explicit hand-traced conservative branch silhouette polygon; antialiasing only on native export
sprites.limit: Left touching neighbor removed using a conservative visible-edge polygon; small branch ambiguities remain.

palette_grading: None. The existing source and periodic source colors are preserved byte-for-byte or source-sampled.

scale_basis.method: Visible individual evergreen silhouettes in actual Dutch Civ4 crop, approximate manual screen-space envelopes, normalized by the manifest local horizontal cell span. These are visual observations, not recovered meshes.
scale_basis.uncertainty: Approximate +/-2 to 3 source screenshot pixels; perspective, overlaps and compression prevent exact isolation.

boreal_caveat: Boreal source contains pale/frosted-looking crowns and thinner, smaller visible silhouettes. These four green conifers provide species-correct edges but do not claim a faithful snow/frost material. Keep this mismatch visible in benchmark review.
native_root_placement: Sprite origin = projected_root_xy - root_anchor * (screen_cell_width/128). Sort by root screen y. Use identical uniform scale on both axes.
known_limits: Silhouettes are manually masked from a dense generated forest material, so some dark touching bough boundaries remain ambiguous.
Four finite edge variants; all keep original light direction and upright orientation.
Bare ground in periodic material is part of its authored interior, not transparent.
The source material is not an exact Civ4 palette or species match; actual screenshot references are benchmark only and no source screenshot pixels enter the reusable game assets.
